use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use Raster.SHAPES

use Math = System.Math
use Square = (row: int, column: int)

let size = 8
let start = (row = 0, column = 0)
let goal = (row = 7, column = 7)

let barrier =
    [(row = 2, column = 4), (row = 2, column = 5),
     (row = 2, column = 6), (row = 3, column = 6),
     (row = 4, column = 6), (row = 5, column = 6),
     (row = 5, column = 5), (row = 5, column = 4),
     (row = 5, column = 3), (row = 5, column = 2),
     (row = 4, column = 2), (row = 3, column = 2)]

at(square: Square) -> int => square.row * size + square.column

square_at(index: int) -> Square =>
    (row = index / size, column = index % size)

blocked(square: Square) -> bool =>
    barrier |> any(other => at(other) == at(square))

entering(square: Square) -> int => if blocked(square) then 100 else 1 fi

remaining(square: Square) -> int =>
    Math.max(Math.abs(goal.row - square.row),
             Math.abs(goal.column - square.column))

inside(square: Square) -> bool =>
    square.row >= 0 /\ square.row < size /\
    square.column >= 0 /\ square.column < size

steps_from(square: Square) -> Pipe[Square] is
    for down in -1::1 do
        for across in -1::1 do
            let next =
                (row = square.row + down,
                 column = square.column + across)

            if (down != 0 \/ across != 0) /\ inside(next) then
                yield next
            fi
        od
    od
si

let cheapest = LIST[int]()
let reached_from = LIST[int]()

for _ in 0..size * size do
    cheapest.add(1_000_000)
    reached_from.add(-1)
od

let open = LIST([start])

cheapest[at(start)] = 0

while open.count > 0 do
    let pick mut = 0

    for which in 1..open.count do
        if cheapest[at(open[which])] + remaining(open[which]) <
                cheapest[at(open[pick])] + remaining(open[pick]) then
            pick = which
        fi
    od

    let square = open[pick]

    open.remove_at(pick)

    if at(square) == at(goal) then
        break
    fi

    for next in steps_from(square) do
        let through = cheapest[at(square)] + entering(next)

        if through < cheapest[at(next)] then
            cheapest[at(next)] = through
            reached_from[at(next)] = at(square)

            open.add(next)
        fi
    od
od

let backwards = LIST[Square]()
let walk mut = at(goal)

while walk >= 0 do
    backwards.add(square_at(walk))
    walk = reached_from[walk]
od

let route =
    (0..backwards.count)
        |> map(step => backwards[backwards.count - 1 - step])
        |> collect_list()

let on_route = SET(route |> map(at))

for row in 0..size do
    write_line(
        (0..size)
            |> map(column =>
                (let square = (row = row, column = column)

                 if on_route.contains(at(square)) then
                     "o"
                 elif blocked(square) then
                     "#"
                 else
                     "."
                 fi))
            |> join(""))
od

write_line("")
write_line("route [{route |> map(s => "({s.row}, {s.column})")
                        |> join(", ")}]")
write_line("cost {cheapest[at(goal)]}")

let image = IMAGE(520, 520)

image.view(-0.15D, -0.15D, 8.15D, 8.15D)

middle(square: Square) ->
        (x: double, y: double) =>
    (x = cast double(square.column) + 0.5D,
     y = cast double(size - square.row) - 0.5D)

let board = SHAPES()

for row in 0..size do
    for column in 0..size do
        let square = (row = row, column = column)
        let centre = middle(square)

        let cell =
            [(x = centre.x - 0.5D, y = centre.y - 0.5D),
             (x = centre.x + 0.5D, y = centre.y - 0.5D),
             (x = centre.x + 0.5D, y = centre.y + 0.5D),
             (x = centre.x - 0.5D, y = centre.y + 0.5D)]

        if blocked(square) then
            board.add(cell, 96ub, 104ub, 124ub)
        elif (row + column) % 2 == 0 then
            board.add(cell, 244ub, 242ub, 236ub)
        else
            board.add(cell, 222ub, 218ub, 208ub)
        fi
    od
od

image.fill(board)

image.colour(40ub, 40ub, 50ub)
image.stroke(1.4D)
image.line([(x = 0.0D, y = 0.0D), (x = 8.0D, y = 0.0D),
            (x = 8.0D, y = 8.0D), (x = 0.0D, y = 8.0D),
            (x = 0.0D, y = 0.0D)])

image.colour(200ub, 48ub, 40ub)
image.stroke(3.0D)
image.line(LIST(route |> map(middle)))

for square in route do
    let centre = middle(square)

    image.dot(centre.x, centre.y, 4.5D)
od

image.colour(24ub, 40ub, 72ub)
image.stroke(2.4D)

for square in [start, goal] do
    let centre = middle(square)

    image.ring(centre.x, centre.y, 9.0D)
od

image.write("route.png")

image.show("route.png")
